title: Technical Assistant Intern
description:
**Date:** 4 Aug 2026
  
  

**Location:** Cisterna di Latina, LT, IT
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
  

**Company:** Zespri Group Limited
  
  

Kō wai mātou? Who are we?
  
  

Zespri is more than simply the world's single\-largest marketer of kiwifruit. We like to think of ourselves as fruit on a mission and as rebels with a cause: to help people, communities and the environment around the world thrive through the goodness of kiwifruit. We are proudly the world's largest marketer of kiwifruit, selling kiwifruit in more than 50 countries. We work with around 2,800 New Zealand and 1,500 international growers and post\-harvest companies to source the best\-quality Zespri Kiwifruit which we supply through our distribution partners to wholesale and retail customers. We are one of New Zealand's best\-known international brands, dedicated to creating sustainable long\-term value for growers.
  
  

He aha te mahi? What's the role?
  
  

We’re looking for a motivated and hands\-on Technical Assistant to support the Kiwifruit Breeding Centre (KBC) in Italy during the harvest period. Based in Latina, this is a great opportunity to gain practical experience across orchard, laboratory and consumer trial activities, while contributing to the development and delivery of new kiwifruit cultivars and rootstocks for Zespri.
  
  

Based within Zespri Fresh Produce Italy and strongly connected to Zespri’s Global Supply team, this role will support the evaluation operations team across a variety of seasonal activities. You’ll be involved in collecting fruit from orchards, preparing and testing samples in the laboratory, supporting sensory and consumer trial activity, and helping ensure data, quality and safety standards are maintained throughout the season.
  
  

**Please note:** This is a fixed\-term contract running from 1 September 2026 to 16 December 2026\.
  
  

**You will be responsible for:**  

Supporting harvest activities, including picking maturity samples, harvesting fruit, grading, packing, sensory activity, following protocols and sorting trays into cool store.
  
Preparing and completing labelling tasks, including printing, tagging and placing labels on bags and trays.
  
Conducting laboratory measurements accurately and thoroughly, in line with instructions and protocols.
  
Monitoring data inputs and highlighting any irregular, duplicate or inconsistent data.
  
Keeping workspaces clean, organised and safe, including warehouse and equipment maintenance.
  
Communicating quickly and clearly with supervisors if there are technical issues, personnel matters or mistakes that need to be resolved.
  
Contributing positively to the wider team by being flexible, collaborative and committed to health, safety and compliance.
  
Ko wai koe? Who are you?
  
  

You’ll be someone who enjoys practical, hands\-on work and has a genuine interest in agriculture, science and the kiwifruit industry. You’re comfortable working in changing seasonal conditions, can follow protocols accurately, and take pride in doing things properly, safely and on time.
  
  

**You’ll bring:**  

Strong attention to detail, accuracy and problem\-solving ability.
  
Good interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate directly and constructively in Italian. English would be an advantage.
  
The ability to work effectively with a diverse range of people across orchard, laboratory and operational environments.
  
Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage tasks, follow protocols and meet deadlines.
  
Confidence using Microsoft Excel and a willingness to learn data collection devices and database systems.
  
The physical ability to lift up to 20 kg, carry trays or crates of fruit safely, and work in all weather conditions.
  
A high school diploma and an interest in agriculture and science.
  
  

Most importantly, you’ll bring a strong work ethic, a positive team mindset and a willingness to get stuck in during a busy and important part of the season.
  
  

He aha e tika ai a Zespri? Why Zespri?
  
  

Our people are what makes our culture so irresistible and uniquely Zespri. We are a passionate and mighty team of 850\+ employees in 23 different locations globally. Working at Zespri is an opportunity to join a fast\-paced, culture\-driven environment unlike any other. We want people who share our values of making it happen, creating real connections, and leaving a legacy. Join us in shaping our future and be part of a truly unique organisation.
  
  

Competitive overall remuneration package.
  
FlexWELL flexible work ethos; WFH \& the office.
  
  

At Zespri, we understand the importance of diverse perspectives and experiences, and a fair hiring process is the first step to getting there. We want to attract a diverse range of people and encourage everyone from all backgrounds and walks of life to apply. Please let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments to take part in the recruitment and selection process by reaching out to our Talent Acquisition team via email at careers@zespri.com.
  
  

Agency
  
  

Zespri will not accept applications or contact from any temporary staffing agency, placement service or professional recruiter for this vacancy (“Agency”).
  
  

Where Zespri requires the support of an agency to fulfil a vacancy, we will proactively seek this support from our network of Agencies. We respectfully ask that you do not contact Zespri or any of its affiliates/employees regarding vacancies, and reserve the right not to reply.
  
  

Zespri will not be responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions or other payments related to such unsolicited resumes.

title: Medical Science Liaison - Oncology (Centro-Nord)
description:
Job Description
  
  

Our Medical Affairs team advances patient care by engaging in scientific exchange with external medical experts and industry leaders ensuring the scientific value of our products is understood. We connect, communicate and train internal employees to ensure a thorough understanding of the science behind the medicine and review further unmet medical needs to support collaboration to further differentiate our portfolio.
  
  

Medical Scientific Liaisons are scientifically trained and credentialed therapeutic area, disease, and product experts who engage in non\-promotional scientific exchange with SLs or KDMs (Scientific Leaders or Key Decision Makers). MSL interactions with SLs and KDMs are built on the credibility of the scientific exchange held. MSLs develop and execute action plans aligned with the Guiding Principles for Ex\-US GMA/OGMA External Stakeholder\-Facing Activities, local and global company policies, local rules regulations, and the Medical Affairs Plan (MAP).
  
  

MSLs liaise between the scientific community and the Company to enhance the comprehension of scientific foundations and goals for approved, in\-development, and active Company\-sponsored trials and/or investigator\-sponsored research studies. The MSL serves as a role model for other field medical team members in ways that include on\-boarding and/or sharing of therapeutic expertise.
  
  

Responsibilities and Primary Activities
  
  

Scientific Exchange
  
  

* Develops professional relationships and engages with national and/or regional SLs to ensure access to medical and scientific information on areas of therapeutic interest and Company products
* Conducts peer\-to\-peer scientific discussions and maintains a reliable presence with those SLs to ensure they have a medical contact within the Company
* Addresses scientific questions and directs SL inquiries on issues outside of MSL scope (e.g., grants) to appropriate Company resources consistent with applicable policies
* Maintains current knowledge and comprehension of dynamic scientific and clinical environment in the Companys Areas of Interest (AOI)


Research
  
  

* Upon request from Global Clinical Trial Operations (GCTO),
* Identifies barriers to patient enrollment and retention efforts to achieve study milestones, recommends study sites, and identifies potential investigators to participate in phase II\-IV clinical development programs
* Addresses questions from investigators and provides information regarding participation in Company\-sponsored clinical studies
* Upon request from Scientific Affairs,
* Enhances the comprehension of the scientific foundations and goals of investigator\-sponsored research
* Identifies barriers to patient enrollment and retention efforts to achieve study milestones
* Initiates discussions with SLs and/or potential investigators that include scientific/data exchange within our AOI to determine the alignment with our research strategies, studies concepts, scientific merit, and qualifications for a specific compound or trial


Working area
  
  

* Emilia Romagna, Toscana e Marche.
* THE CANDIDATE IS REQUIRED TO LIVE WITHIN THE WORKING AREA IN ONE OF THE REGIONS MENTIONED ABOVE


Your Profile
  
  

**Qualification Experience:**  

An advanced scientific degree is strongly preferred, such asMD (or equivalent MB.Ch.B.), PharmD, or Ph.D. in Alife science, preferably with clinical knowledge of the assigned therapeutic area. At a minimum, a college education degree in pharmacy.
  
  

**Skills:**  

* Minimum of 2 years of pharmaceutical experience is strongly preferred. Experience in the assigned therapeutic area is highly preferred
* Strong scientific baseline knowledge in assigned therapeutic areas (Breast e Gynecological ), clinical trial methods, implementation, and data interpretation, sound scientific and clinical judgment, and eagerness to continue to learn more in depth about a specific therapeutic area
* Ability to present scientific and other technical information with confidence, in a way that engenders trust and credibility
* Excellent communication skills across a variety of internal and external audiences including listening skills and probing skills
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to function within a team environment
* Ability to handle multiple tasks at the same time and work under pressure


The salary range for this position is € 49\.900 \- € 84\.800
  
  

This is the lowest and highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. This will be based on an individual’s experience, skills, organizational needs and compensation levels within their peer group. If applicable, employees may also be eligible for annual bonus and long\-term incentives or other benefits. Our Talent Acquisition team will provide further information to you, if applicable.
  
  

This role is part of national collective labor agreement “NCLA” “Quadro” “A3” .
  
  

**Required Skills:**  

Adaptability, Adaptability, Advisory Board Development, Analytical Problem Solving, Analytical Thinking, Clinical Development, Clinical Programs, Clinical Research, Clinical Risk Management, Clinical Site Management, Clinical Supplies Management, Clinical Trial Agreements (CTA), Clinical Trial Compliance, Clinical Trial Methodology, Clinical Trials, Data Analysis, ICH GCP Guidelines, Interpersonal Relationships, Medical Affairs, Medical Knowledge, Molecular Oncology, Pharmaceutical Industry, Pharmaceutical Medical Affairs, Scientific Communications, Scientific Leadership {\+ 1 more}

**PTV Group. Empowering mobility as part of Umovity.**
------------------------------------------------------


At PTV, we work together to make a real difference — every single day.
  

You can share your ideas, take on responsibility, and work with passionate colleagues to develop pioneering solutions that make tomorrow’s mobility safer, smarter, and more sustainable. Our culture is built on trust, creativity, and teamwork — because we believe that the best ideas emerge when people feel empowered to share and grow.

**Your Mission**
----------------


As Senior People Business Partner, you will translate business strategy into people priorities and enable leaders to build high\-performing teams in a dynamic international environment.


You will:


* Partner with leaders to develop and execute people strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Coach and challenge managers on leadership, organizational effectiveness, talent development and performance management.
* Drive organizational design, change management and transformation initiatives.
* Lead workforce planning and succession planning together with business leaders.
* Support employee engagement and foster an inclusive, high\-performance culture.
* Advise on employee relations and Italian labor law while ensuring compliance with local regulations.
* Use HR analytics and business insights to identify trends and recommend data\-driven actions.
* Act as a trusted partner during periods of growth, change and organizational transformation.
**What you bring to the team**
------------------------------


* Several years of experience as an People/HR Business Partner in an international and matrix organization.
* Strong knowledge of Italian labor law and HR best practices across the employee lifecycle.
* Proven experience in leadership coaching, organizational development and change management.
* Ability to build credibility and influence senior stakeholders through trust and business insight.
* Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into meaningful business decisions.
* Fluent Italian and English.

**Who You Are**
---------------


You understand that great HR is about creating business value through people.


You are:


* A trusted advisor who builds strong relationships across all organizational levels.
* Curious about the business and motivated to understand what drives success.
* Confident in navigating complexity and making thoughtful decisions.
* Empathetic, while maintaining professionalism and objectivity.
* Passionate about developing leaders and enabling high\-performing teams.
* Comfortable challenging the status quo and driving continuous improvement.
* Resilient, collaborative and eager to make a lasting impact.
**Why Join PTV?**
-----------------


At PTV, you will become part of an international technology company whose solutions contribute to more efficient, sustainable and intelligent mobility worldwide.


We offer:


* A People \& Culture role with significant influence on business success.
* An international, collaborative and inclusive working environment.
* The opportunity to shape organizational growth and transformation.
* Flexible working arrangements and a healthy work\-life balance.
* Professional development and continuous learning opportunities.
* A culture built on trust, respect, innovation and teamwork.
**Our People Philosophy**
-------------------------


At PTV, we believe that business success starts with people.


We build trusted partnerships, empower leaders and foster an environment where individuals can thrive. We value curiosity, accountability and collaboration. We recognize that emotions are part of every meaningful workplace interaction and approach them with empathy, professionalism and respect. By combining people\-centric leadership with business excellence, we enable our organization to achieve sustainable success.


**If you are excited about partnering with leaders, developing people and shaping the future of an international technology company, we would love to hear from you. Join us and help move the world forward.**


* Claudia Wankmüller
* Vice President Human Resources

The position is located in the Office of the Ombudsperson and Mediation Services (OBD) in WFP HQ, Rome, Italy, and reports to the Ombudsperson and Director of the Office.

**JOB PURPOSE:**


To lead the promotion of informal conflict resolution as a key element of WFP’s internal justice system by developing outreach strategies, enhancing conflict prevention and resolution skills through training, and providing professional mediation and conflict resolution services. The role also involves the provision of informal conflict resolution services to all employees and identifies systemic issues and trends to facilitate workplace culture change.

**ACCOUNTABILITIES**:

* Develop and oversee the implementation of the OBD’s outreach and communication strategy aimed at promoting awareness and understanding of its role and services in informal conflict resolution. Increase the visibility of the Office, and its services, including the Respectful Workplace Allies (RWA) programme, and clarify its position within WFP’s internal justice system.
* Oversee the production of informational and educational materials related to OBD’s activities, conflict resolution competencies, and interpersonal skills to ensure effective design and delivery of products.
* Design and lead communication and engagement campaigns for specific events, such as the International Ombuds Day and the release of OBD’s Annual Report ensuring these campaigns effectively promote OBD’s role and activities, enhancing staff engagement and awareness.
* Build effective collaborations and partnerships internally and externally to align activities and ensure a coherent approach to communications in line with WFP policies and strategies.
* Stay abreast of new developments, policies, and strategies within WFP, as well as of new organizational requirements and their implications for OBD. Coordinate OBD’s timely input on these developments, ensuring necessary responses and adjustments align with evolving organizational needs.
* Lead OBD’s Capacity Building Programme for all WFP employees and managed collaboration with stakeholders on capacity\-building efforts within WFP. Oversee the development of new training formats and ensure integration of WFP’s updated frameworks and policies into OBD’s existing training materials as appropriate. Design and implement targeted capacity\-building initiatives for WFP’s Respectful Workplace Advisors.
* Identify systemic issues, trends, and patterns in the workplace, and provide early warning upward feedback.
* Lead the coordination and review of the drafting process of OBD’s Annual Report and draft sections as required. Oversee the design and publication process in collaboration with the Executive Board Secretariat and an external designer. Furthermore, develop a strategic communication plan to disseminate the report’s findings to WFP’s employees, stakeholders, and the Member States.
* Prepare briefings for the Ombudsperson to present to the Executive Board, senior management, and other WFP bodies. Provide strategic advice to the Ombudsperson on organizational trends and systemic issues that require attention, while also enhancing outreach and liaison efforts with Member States. \- Provide a comprehensive range of ombuds services to WFP employees, including those in offices not covered by OBD’s network of outposted Ombuds Officers. Operate in compliance with the Standards of Practice for UN System Ombudsman and Mediators, and safeguard independence, impartiality, neutrality, confidentiality, and informality.
* Engage with employees and managers in confidential one\-on\-one meetings to explore options for addressing workplace concerns. Provide coaching to empower them to address their issues autonomously and guide them to adequate sources of information.
* Take responsibility for an equitable and inclusive workplace that incorporates all WFP diversity and inclusion framework dimensions.
* Perform other duties as required.

**Education:**

* Advanced university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in Conflict Resolution, Social Sciences, Law, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Communications, or other related field, or first university degree with additional years of related work experience and/or training.

**Experience:**

* At least 8 years of progressively responsible professional experience in conflict resolution, mediation, organizational communications, or related areas.
* Experience in leading communication strategies and outreach efforts, ideally within a large international organization.
* Proven experience in developing and delivering capacity\-building programs, particularly related to conflict prevention and resolution.
* Experience in providing mediation or other informal conflict resolution services in line with international ombuds standards.

**Knowledge \& Skills:**

* Excellent knowledge of conflict resolution practices and the principles of ombudsman practice.
* Ability to identify workplace trends and provide strategic advice to senior management.
* Familiarity with developing training materials and overseeing capacity\-building initiatives.
* Demonstrated writing and editorial skills for producing reports and informational materials.
* Skilled in building partnerships and collaboration both internally and externally.
* Excellent project management skills, with experience in overseeing events and campaigns.

**Language:**

* Fluency (Level C) in English. Intermediate knowledge (level B) of a second official UN language: Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, Spanish, and/or Portuguese (a WFP working language).

description:
**Description:**
----------------


***Where talent becomes impact, innovation begins.***

 *In DGS il talento diventa impatto perché entra in progetti reali, dove competenze tecnologiche, visione di business e collaborazione si incontrano per accompagnare aziende e organizzazioni nei loro percorsi di evoluzione.*

*Siamo una* ***tech company*** *in crescita, con competenze integrate in* ***Cybersecurity, AI \& Data, Digital Engineering*** *e soluzioni per la* ***Smart Enterprise.*** *Lavoriamo per modernizzare processi, sistemi e infrastrutture, rendendoli più sicuri, evoluti e pronti a crescere.*

*Ma la tecnologia, da sola, non basta. A fare la differenza sono le persone: professionisti che collaborano su progetti complessi, condividono competenze, imparano continuamente e trasformano sfide tecnologiche e di business in soluzioni concrete.*

*Entrare in DGS significa trovare un contesto in cui crescere, contribuire e mettere a valore la propria esperienza, a ogni livello di seniority. Cerchiamo persone curiose, responsabili e orientate al risultato, capaci di lavorare insieme a team, clienti e stakeholder con ownership, collaboration, continuous learning e value creation.*

 ***Porta il tuo talento in DGS. Be part of what’s next.***

  

Per il potenziamento del nostro **Competence Center PLM,** siamo alla ricerca di un professionista con esperienza consolidata su **PTC Windchill**, con specializzazione sul modulo **Windchill MPMLink** e sui processi di **Manufacturing Process Management.** La risorsa sarà coinvolta in progetti di trasformazione digitale dell’area *Manufacturing*, operando come riferimento funzionale e tecnico nella progettazione e implementazione dei processi che collegano la definizione ingegneristica del prodotto alla pianificazione e all’esecuzione della produzione.

 **Principali responsabilità:**

  

* Analisi e modellazione dei processi Manufacturing in ambito PLM.
* Raccolta, formalizzazione e validazione dei requisiti funzionali.
* Configurazione e utilizzo avanzato di Windchill MPMLink.
* Gestione della trasformazione e riconciliazione traEngineering BOM ed Manufacturing BOM.
* Definizione di regole di trasformazione, equivalenza, propagazione e sincronizzazione eBOM–mBOM.
* Configurazione e gestione di strutture Manufacturing specifiche per plant, stabilimento o linea produttiva.
* Definizione e gestione di Process Plan, routing, sequenze, operazioni e sotto\-operazioni.
* Allocazione di parti, materiali, documenti, attrezzature e risorse alle operazioni produttive.
* Gestione di manufacturing resources, tooling, work center, capability e risorse umane o produttive.
* Definizione e pubblicazione di work instruction digitali, comprensive di contenuti documentali e rappresentazioni 2D/3D.
* Gestione della configurazione, delle varianti e delle effettività in ambito Manufacturing.
* Analisi dell’impatto delle modifiche Engineering sulle strutture e sui processi produttivi.
* Integrazione dei processi MPMLink con change management, lifecycle e release process di Windchill.
* Supporto alla definizione delle integrazioni tra Windchill e sistemi ERP, MES e applicazioni di fabbrica.
* Supporto ai test funzionali, System Integration Test e User Acceptance Test.
* Predisposizione di specifiche funzionali, documentazione di configurazione e manuali operativi.
* Formazione e affiancamento agli utenti Manufacturing Engineering.

 **Competenze tecniche richieste:**

  

* Esperienza significativa su PTC Windchill PDMLink.
* Esperienza specifica di almeno due anni su Windchill MPMLink.
* Conoscenza approfondita del BOM Transformer.
* Conoscenza del Process Plan Browser e del Manufacturing Resource Browser.
* Esperienza nella gestione di eBOM, mBOM, process plan e manufacturing resources.
* Conoscenza dei meccanismi di equivalenza, consumo, allocazione e riconciliazione tra strutture Engineering e Manufacturing.
* Esperienza nella gestione di plant, view, context, lifecycle, versioning, effectivity e configuration specification.
* Conoscenza dei processi di industrializzazione, pianificazione produttiva e gestione delle modifiche di prodotto e processo.
* Capacità di definire modelli dati, attributi, relazioni e regole operative in ambito Manufacturing.
* Conoscenza delle modalità di pubblicazione dei dati verso ERP e MES.
* Capacità di analizzare problematiche di coerenza tra BOM ingegneristiche e produttive.
* Esperienza nella redazione di documentazione funzionale e tecnica.
* Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata.

 **Competenze preferenziali:**

  

* Esperienza con Windchill 12 o versioni successive.
* Conoscenza di Windchill ESI e delle integrazioni con SAP.
* Esperienza nell’integrazione Windchill–MES.
* Conoscenza di Creo View e dei processi di visualizzazione 3D applicati alle work instruction.
* Esperienza su Windchill REST Services, customization Java e servizi di integrazione.
* Conoscenza di ThingWorx Navigate o soluzioni PTC per il Manufacturing.
* Esperienza nella migrazione di dati Manufacturing da sistemi legacy verso Windchill.
* Conoscenza di processi industriali complessi nei settori Aerospace \& Defence, Automotive, Transportation o Industrial Manufacturing.
* Esperienza in attività di assessment, solution design, configurazione e roll\-out multi\-plant.

  

Sede: **Roma** (modalità ibrida)

  

Altre informazioni

*Nel caso in cui il tuo curriculum sia valutato in linea rispetto alla posizione, organizzeremo un primo incontro per approfondire la reciproca conoscenza. Diversamente conserveremo il tuo curriculum all'interno del nostro database e sarà nostra premura ricontattarti in futuro, qualora si aprissero opportunità coerenti con il tuo percorso e le tue competenze. Il presente annuncio si rivolge ai candidati di ambo i sessi (L. 903/77\).*

title: Responsabile di Negozio - Roma
description:
Adopt Parfums, azienda francese e profumiere n. 1 per volume di vendite in Francia, è finalmente arrivata in Italia, pronta a democratizzare l’industria del profumo con un concetto innovativo e il suo motto: *Grandi Profumi accessibili a tutti.*


Adopt Parfums continua la sua espansione in Italia, ed è per questo che siamo alla ricerca di Responsabile di Negozio per i nostri futuri puntos vendita a **Roma, Centri Commerciali Porta di Roma i Roma Est.**

  

Un professionista delle vendite con la passione per il mondo della bellezza, unisciti a noi per condividere l'avventura di un ‘insegna in crescita’!


Missione:


* Alle dipendenze di un Direttore Regionale, sei responsabile di tutti gli aspetti del punto vendita e sei un ambasciatore del nostro marchio e dei nostri valori. La tua priorità in ogni momento: la soddisfazione dei nostri clienti.
* Siete fortemente orientati all'accoglienza, alla consulenza e alla fidelizzazione dei clienti e garantite una qualità ottimale del servizio nel negozio.
* Sviluppate le prestazioni commerciali del negozio grazie alla buona gestione degli incassi e al monitoraggio dei diversi indicatori: CA, scontrino medio, tasso di conversione, produttività oraria, obiettivi collettivi, ecc.
* Incoraggiate il vostro team nel rispetto dei valori aziendali e in una logica di sviluppo dei talenti.
* Incrementate le vendite garantendo un servizio clienti e un'immagine del negozio impeccabili.
* Assicurate la gestione amministrativa, delle risorse umane e della logistica del negozio. Garantite gli standard di qualità in termini di immagine (presentazione dei prodotti, merchandising e pulizia del negozio).
* Siete responsabili del buon funzionamento del punto vendita nel rispetto delle procedure e dell'adozione e diffusione dei valori aziendali.

  

L'ideale è avere un profilo commerciale combinato con una formazione estetica. Avete una comprovata esperienza nelle vendite e nella gestione dei team. Il vostro background vi permette di padroneggiare il monitoraggio degli indicatori commerciali, l'eccellenza del servizio clienti e la gestione della prossimità. Siete totalmente orientati al cliente, dinamici, reattivi e proattivi. Vi preoccupate di essere un esempio, comunicate in modo rispettoso ed efficace con i vostri team. Il vostro interesse per l'ambiente cosmetico è un elemento indispensabile per riuscire in questa missione.
